<h1>Jun Yamamoto</h1>
<p class="home-intro__role">PhD candidate in Network Science</p>
<p class="home-intro__affiliation">Department of Network and Data Science<br>Central European University · Vienna, Austria</p>

<p class="home-intro__summary">I am a theoretical network scientist, investigating the organizing principles of network structures and dynamics using statistical physics. 
My active research topics include physical networks, network coarse-graining and fractality, and network diffusion and synchronization.</p>

## Research

::: {.section-intro}
My research focuses on the structure and dynamics of physical and fractal networks, exploring how network topology and geometry influence transport and collective behavior.
:::
